title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Rule on the Holiday Pay Share by Average Weekly Hours
content:
**(1)** For a holiday-pay report on Unemployment Benefit Claims, the holiday pay share follows the average hours of the claimant's work schedule: the window hours divided by the number of certified weeks in the history window, on the certifications of the claimant's most recent earlier claim of the same program. Where no week was certified in the window, the average is zero.

**(2)** The holiday pay share is:

| Average hours per certified week in the window | Holiday pay share |
|---|---|
| Below 10 (the low-average hours) | 0.5 (the low-schedule share) |
| At least 10 but below 20 (the mid-average hours) | 0.75 (the mid-schedule share) |
| At least 20 | One |

## Hypothetical cases

| Window hours | Certified weeks in the window | Average | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 54.0 | 6 | 9.0 | 0.5 |
| 60.0 | 6 | 10.0 | 0.75 |
| 120.0 | 6 | 20.0 | One |
| 0.0 | 0 | 0 | 0.5 |
